Discover external metrics like ARI and NMI

Learn to interpret clustering evaluation results

metrics.name: Silhouette Score
metrics.description: Measures how similar points are to their own cluster vs other clusters (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Calinski-Harabasz Index
metrics.description: Ratio of between-cluster to within-cluster variance (higher is better)

metrics.name: Davies-Bouldin Index
metrics.description: Average similarity between clusters (lower is better)

metrics.name: Dunn Index
metrics.description: Ratio of minimum inter-cluster to maximum intra-cluster distance (higher is better)

metrics.name: Adjusted Rand Index
metrics.description: Similarity to ground truth, adjusted for chance (range: -1 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: Normalized Mutual Information
metrics.description: Information-theoretic measure of similarity to ground truth (range: 0 to 1, higher is better)

metrics.name: V-Measure
metrics.description: Harmonic mean of homogeneity and completeness (range: 0 to 1, higher is better)
